title: Nightscout Sync (REST-API) disabled after scanning BlueJay's QR Code
symptom: After initial BlueJay GTS setup with scanning QR Code, BG values stopped being uploaded to Nightscout. Nightscout Sync (REST-API) was disabled. Issue replicated multiple times after resetting BlueJay GTS to factory default settings.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the fix is identified as a code change.
fix: The issue was fixed in a nightly release (2021.09.02) and confirmed by the user. The fix commit is 727aeaffc6354edf4bced6a95531a1758cad4c4e.
